command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ssh=Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('SSH_COMMAND=' + $ssh.Source); $ver=(ssh -V 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim(); Write-Output ('SSH_VERSION=' + $ver); $svc=Get-Service ssh-agent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($svc){Write-Output ('SSH_AGENT_STATUS=' + $svc.Status); Write-Output ('SSH_AGENT_STARTTYPE=' + $svc.StartType)}else{Write-Output 'SSH_AGENT_STATUS=NOT_INSTALLED'}; $sshDir=Join-Path $HOME '.ssh'; if(Test-Path $sshDir){Get-ChildItem $sshDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if($_.PSIsContainer){Write-Output ('SSH_ITEM_DIR=' + $_.Name)} else {Write-Output ('SSH_ITEM_FILE=' + $_.Name)} }}; $cfg=Join-Path $sshDir 'config'; $aliases=@(); if(Test-Path $cfg){ $null=Get-Content $cfg; $lines=Get-Content $cfg; $current=$null; foreach($line in $lines){ $t=$line.Trim(); if($t -match '^(?i)Host\s+(.+)$' -and $Matches[1] -notmatch '[*!?]'){ $current=$Matches[1].Trim(); $aliases += $current; Write-Output ('SSH_ALIAS=' + $current) } elseif($current -and $t -match '^(?i)HostName\s+(.+)$'){ Write-Output ('SSH_HOSTNAME_FOR_ALIAS=' + $current + '|' + $Matches[1].Trim()) } elseif($current -and $t -match '^(?i)User\s+(.+)$'){ Write-Output ('SSH_USER_FOR_ALIAS=' + $current + '|' + $Matches[1].Trim()) } elseif($current -and $t -match '^(?i)IdentityFile\s+(.+)$'){ Write-Output ('SSH_IDENTITY_CONFIGURED=' + $current + '|YES') } }; Write-Output ('SSH_CONFIG_PRESENT=YES') } else {Write-Output 'SSH_CONFIG_PRESENT=NO'}; $agentKeys=(ssh-add -l 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim(); if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){Write-Output 'SSH_AGENT_KEYS=YES'}else{Write-Output 'SSH_AGENT_KEYS=NO'}; Write-Output ('FRED_RELAY_HINT=' + $(if($aliases -match '(?i)fred|shop|oracle|vivaliz'){($aliases -match '(?i)fred|shop|oracle|vivaliz' | Select-Object -First 1)}else{'NONE'}))
reason: Safely inventory existing Windows SSH configuration and identify the ShopVivaliz VM alias without exposing credentials
